implementation_note: First implementation slice of the milestone-integrated SDK plan; delivered inside the existing units owner, not as a separate SDK phase.
app_features: om9-app --no-default-features (standalone Controller/document/scene/archive; no OCCT adapter, no FreeCAD/Rhino host)
asserted_semantics: A document that states no tolerance reports null; the host never substitutes the OM9 template policy.
A bare length number uses the document display unit; an explicit token (mm, cm, m, in, ft, um) carries its own unit; results are canonical millimetres.
A bare angle number, deg and ° are degrees; an explicit rad token converts; results are canonical degrees plus an explicit radian value.
parse_coordinates uses the command prompt grammar x,y[,z] in the display unit with z defaulting to zero; the result is a pre-CPlane millimetre tuple.
Non-finite or malformed text is a typed error, never zero; a refused host call poisons the invocation so no partial command publishes.
Reading units or parsing text stages no mutation: Undo/Redo stay empty and the document is unchanged.
